analyses_failure_check.name: analyses_failure_check
analyses_failure_check.value: ("analyses"."status" = 'failed') = ("analyses"."failure" is not null) and coalesce("analyses"."failure", 'timeout') in ('timeout', 'illegal', 'no_evaluation', 'inconsistent', 'disconnect', 'protocol', 'expired')

analyses_analyzer_check.name: analyses_analyzer_check
analyses_analyzer_check.value: (("analyses"."status" = 'queued') = ("analyses"."analyzer_bot_id" is null)) or ("analyses"."status" = 'failed' and "analyses"."analyzer_bot_id" is null)

analyses_involved_check.name: analyses_involved_check
analyses_involved_check.value: "analyses"."involved" in (0, 1) and ("analyses"."involved" = 0 or "analyses"."analyzer_bot_id" is not null)

analyses_analyzer_meaning_check.name: analyses_analyzer_meaning_check
analyses_analyzer_meaning_check.value: ("analyses"."analyzer_meaning" is null) = ("analyses"."analyzer_scale" is null) and coalesce("analyses"."analyzer_meaning", 'raw') in ('expected', 'raw')

analyses_analyzer_scale_check.name: analyses_analyzer_scale_check
analyses_analyzer_scale_check.value: "analyses"."analyzer_scale" is null or ("analyses"."analyzer_bot_id" is not null and "analyses"."analyzer_scale" > 0 and "analyses"."analyzer_scale" <= 1000000)

analyses_analyzer_cuts_check.name: analyses_analyzer_cuts_check
analyses_analyzer_cuts_check.value: ("analyses"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" is null) = ("analyses"."analyzer_cut_mistake" is null) and ("analyses"."analyzer_cut_mistake" is null) = ("analyses"."analyzer_cut_blunder" is null) and ("analyses"."analyzer_cut_blunder" is null or ("analyses"."analyzer_scale" is not null and "analyses"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" > 0 and "analyses"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" < "analyses"."analyzer_cut_mistake" and "analyses"."analyzer_cut_mistake" < "analyses"."analyzer_cut_blunder" and "analyses"."analyzer_cut_blunder" <= 2))

analysis_lines_value_check.name: analysis_lines_value_check
analysis_lines_value_check.value: "analysis_lines"."heuristic" is not null or "analysis_lines"."win_in" is not null

bots_levels_check.name: bots_levels_check
bots_levels_check.value: "bots"."levels" is null or (json_valid("bots"."levels") and substr("bots"."levels", 1, 1) = '{' and length("bots"."levels") <= 16384)

bots_analyzer_check.name: bots_analyzer_check
bots_analyzer_check.value: ("bots"."analyzer_while_playing" is null or "bots"."analyzer_while_playing" in (0, 1)) and ("bots"."analyzer_max_seconds" is null) = ("bots"."analyzer_lines" is null) and ("bots"."analyzer_lines" is null) = ("bots"."analyzer_while_playing" is null)

bots_analyzer_meaning_check.name: bots_analyzer_meaning_check
bots_analyzer_meaning_check.value: ("bots"."analyzer_meaning" is null) = ("bots"."analyzer_scale" is null) and coalesce("bots"."analyzer_meaning", 'raw') in ('expected', 'raw')

bots_analyzer_scale_check.name: bots_analyzer_scale_check
bots_analyzer_scale_check.value: "bots"."analyzer_scale" is null or ("bots"."analyzer_lines" is not null and "bots"."analyzer_scale" > 0 and "bots"."analyzer_scale" <= 1000000)

bots_analyzer_cuts_check.name: bots_analyzer_cuts_check
bots_analyzer_cuts_check.value: ("bots"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" is null) = ("bots"."analyzer_cut_mistake" is null) and ("bots"."analyzer_cut_mistake" is null) = ("bots"."analyzer_cut_blunder" is null) and ("bots"."analyzer_cut_blunder" is null or ("bots"."analyzer_scale" is not null and "bots"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" > 0 and "bots"."analyzer_cut_inaccuracy" < "bots"."analyzer_cut_mistake" and "bots"."analyzer_cut_mistake" < "bots"."analyzer_cut_blunder" and "bots"."analyzer_cut_blunder" <= 2))

games_pairing_check.name: games_pairing_check
games_pairing_check.value: ("games"."pairing_id" is null and "games"."pairing_game" is null) or ("games"."pairing_id" is not null and coalesce("games"."pairing_game", 0) in (1, 2) and "games"."challenger_bot_id" is not null)

games_series_check.name: games_series_check
games_series_check.value: ("games"."series_id" is null and "games"."series_game" is null) or ("games"."series_id" is not null and coalesce("games"."series_game", 0) between 1 and 10 and "games"."challenger_bot_id" is not null and "games"."pairing_id" is null)

games_x_level_check.name: games_x_level_check
games_x_level_check.value: "games"."x_level" is null or (json_valid("games"."x_level") and substr("games"."x_level", 1, 1) = '{' and length("games"."x_level") <= 1024)

games_o_level_check.name: games_o_level_check
games_o_level_check.value: "games"."o_level" is null or (json_valid("games"."o_level") and substr("games"."o_level", 1, 1) = '{' and length("games"."o_level") <= 1024)

games_level_seat_check.name: games_level_seat_check
games_level_seat_check.value: "games"."user_side" is null or (case "games"."user_side" when 'x' then "games"."x_level" else "games"."o_level" end) is null

games_unrated_by_choice_check.name: games_unrated_by_choice_check
games_unrated_by_choice_check.value: "games"."unrated_by_choice" in (0, 1) and ("games"."unrated_by_choice" = 0 or "games"."series_id" is not null or ("games"."x_level" is null and "games"."o_level" is null and ("games"."user_id" is not null or ("games"."challenger_bot_id" is not null and "games"."pairing_id" is null))))

games_seats_check.name: games_seats_check
games_seats_check.value:
(
                "games"."user_id" is not null and "games"."guest_name" is null and "games"."bot_id" is not null and "games"."user_side" is not null
                and "games"."challenger_bot_id" is null and "games"."dest_bot_id" is null and "games"."challenger_side" is null
            ) or (
                "games"."user_id" is null and "games"."guest_name" is not null and "games"."bot_id" is not null and "games"."user_side" is not null
                and "games"."challenger_bot_id" is null and "games"."dest_bot_id" is null and "games"."challenger_side" is null
            ) or (
                "games"."user_id" is null and "games"."guest_name" is null and "games"."bot_id" is null and "games"."user_side" is null
                and "games"."challenger_bot_id" is not null and "games"."dest_bot_id" is not null and "games"."challenger_side" is not null
                and "games"."challenger_bot_id" <> "games"."dest_bot_id"
            )

own_lines_value_check.name: own_lines_value_check
own_lines_value_check.value: "own_lines"."heuristic" is not null or "own_lines"."win_in" is not null

own_values_meaning_check.name: own_values_meaning_check
own_values_meaning_check.value: ("own_values"."meaning" is null) = ("own_values"."scale" is null) and coalesce("own_values"."meaning", 'raw') in ('expected', 'raw')

own_values_cuts_check.name: own_values_cuts_check
own_values_cuts_check.value: ("own_values"."cut_inaccuracy" is null) = ("own_values"."cut_mistake" is null) and ("own_values"."cut_mistake" is null) = ("own_values"."cut_blunder" is null) and ("own_values"."cut_blunder" is null or ("own_values"."scale" is not null and "own_values"."cut_inaccuracy" > 0 and "own_values"."cut_inaccuracy" < "own_values"."cut_mistake" and "own_values"."cut_mistake" < "own_values"."cut_blunder" and "own_values"."cut_blunder" <= 2))

reports_name_check.name: reports_name_check
reports_name_check.value: "reports"."reporter_name" is null or length("reports"."reporter_name") between 1 and 100

reports_email_check.name: reports_email_check
reports_email_check.value: "reports"."reporter_email" is null or (length("reports"."reporter_email") between 3 and 254 and "reports"."reporter_email" like '%_@_%')

reports_note_check.name: reports_note_check
reports_note_check.value: ("reports"."status" = 'closed') = ("reports"."note" is not null) and ("reports"."note" is null or length("reports"."note") between 1 and 500)

series_a_level_check.name: series_a_level_check
series_a_level_check.value: "series"."a_level" is null or (json_valid("series"."a_level") and substr("series"."a_level", 1, 1) = '{' and length("series"."a_level") <= 1024)

series_b_level_check.name: series_b_level_check
series_b_level_check.value: "series"."b_level" is null or (json_valid("series"."b_level") and substr("series"."b_level", 1, 1) = '{' and length("series"."b_level") <= 1024)

series_rated_check.name: series_rated_check
series_rated_check.value: "series"."rated" in (0, 1) and ("series"."rated" = 0 or ("series"."a_level" is null and "series"."b_level" is null))

series_end_check.name: series_end_check
series_end_check.value: ("series"."status" = 'cut_short' and coalesce("series"."end_reason", '') in ('offline', 'closed', 'clock', 'busy', 'refused', 'tournament', 'banned', 'delisted', 'deleted', 'daily_cap', 'aborted')) or ("series"."status" = 'stopped' and coalesce("series"."end_reason", '') in ('starter', 'owner', 'operator')) or ("series"."status" in ('running', 'finished') and "series"."end_reason" is null)

series_end_bot_check.name: series_end_bot_check
series_end_bot_check.value: "series"."end_bot" is null or ("series"."end_bot" in ('a', 'b') and "series"."status" in ('cut_short', 'stopped'))

sessions_discord_username_check.name: sessions_discord_username_check
sessions_discord_username_check.value: "sessions"."discord_username" is null or length("sessions"."discord_username") between 1 and 32

sessions_discord_display_name_check.name: sessions_discord_display_name_check
sessions_discord_display_name_check.value: "sessions"."discord_display_name" is null or ("sessions"."discord_username" is not null and length("sessions"."discord_display_name") between 1 and 32)

tournament_entries_reason_check.name: tournament_entries_reason_check
tournament_entries_reason_check.value: ("tournament_entries"."state" = 'left_out' and coalesce("tournament_entries"."reason", '') in ('daily_cap', 'clock')) or ("tournament_entries"."state" = 'withdrawn' and coalesce("tournament_entries"."reason", '') in ('missed', 'banned', 'delisted', 'deleted')) or ("tournament_entries"."state" not in ('left_out', 'withdrawn') and "tournament_entries"."reason" is null)

tournament_pairings_game1_check.name: tournament_pairings_game1_check
tournament_pairings_game1_check.value: ("tournament_pairings"."game1" in ('pending', 'live', 'not_played', 'aborted') and "tournament_pairings"."game1_seat" is null) or ("tournament_pairings"."game1" = 'played' and ("tournament_pairings"."game1_seat" is null or "tournament_pairings"."game1_seat" in ('first', 'second'))) or ("tournament_pairings"."game1" in ('no_show', 'forfeit') and coalesce("tournament_pairings"."game1_seat", '') in ('first', 'second', 'both'))

tournament_pairings_game2_check.name: tournament_pairings_game2_check
tournament_pairings_game2_check.value: ("tournament_pairings"."game2" in ('pending', 'live', 'not_played', 'aborted') and "tournament_pairings"."game2_seat" is null) or ("tournament_pairings"."game2" = 'played' and ("tournament_pairings"."game2_seat" is null or "tournament_pairings"."game2_seat" in ('first', 'second'))) or ("tournament_pairings"."game2" in ('no_show', 'forfeit') and coalesce("tournament_pairings"."game2_seat", '') in ('first', 'second', 'both'))

tournaments_name_check.name: tournaments_name_check
tournaments_name_check.value: length("tournaments"."name") between 3 and 40 and "tournaments"."name" not glob '*[^ -~]*'
